parts:
Two parallel identical conducting wires with radii of 1 millimeter are spaced 1 meter apart. Given ε0 [epsilon naught] as 9 x 10-12 coulombs squared per newton meters squared, if a 10 volt potential difference is applied to the wires, which of the following is the force in newtons per meter between the wires?
W) 3 x 10-7
X) 3 x 10-9
Y) 3 x 10-11
Z) 3 x 10-13

Y) 3 × 10−11
Z) 3 × 10−13
